Application.Text2:
protocols:
protocol_id: P01
name: SeeDB标准透明
sample_scope: 已固定小鼠组织；样本大小和琼脂糖包埋可延长渗透时间
steps: 
  [1]     stage: graded_equilibration
    operation: 固定组织依次进入20%、40%、60%果糖
    conditions: 各为w/v；25°C；含0.5% α-thioglycerol
    duration_original: 4–8 h each
    time_role: stage_duration
    duration_hours: 
      [1] 12
      [2] 24
    notes: 三阶段合计12–24 h；不把4–8 h当三阶段总时间
  [2]     stage: graded_equilibration
    operation: 80%果糖
    conditions: w/v；25°C；含0.5% α-thioglycerol
    duration_original: 12 h
    time_role: stage_duration
    duration_hours: 12
    notes: 
  [3]     stage: graded_equilibration
    operation: 100%果糖
    conditions: w/v；25°C；含0.5% α-thioglycerol
    duration_original: 12 h
    time_role: stage_duration
    duration_hours: 12
    notes: 
  [4]     stage: final_clearing
    operation: SeeDB终末平衡
    conditions: 80.2% w/w果糖，约115% w/v；0.5% α-thioglycerol；25°C
    duration_original: 24 h
    time_role: stage_duration
    duration_hours: 24
    notes: 
source_locators: 
  [1]     source_id: S1
    pdf_pages_1based: 
      [1] 9
    locator: Optical clearing using SeeDB
  [2]     source_id: S2
    pdf_pages_1based: 
      [1] 11
    locator: Supplementary Fig.5a
time_summary: 
  reported: approximately 3 d; Supplementary Fig.5a day0–day3
  calculated_stage_sum_hours: 
    [1] 60
    [2] 72
  basis: Methods前三阶段各4–8h；S5示意取各8h；不是冲突修正或通用承诺
end_to_end_workflow_duration: not_reported; excludes pre-existing labeling, fixation, mounting and image acquisition
